WEB.title: World English Bible Classic
WEB.introduction: A public-domain translation into modern English. The Classic edition uses American English and “Yahweh” for God’s name in the Old Testament.
WEB.edition_note: This package includes its Deuterocanonical/Apocryphal books.

KJV.title: King James Version — 1769 text
KJV.introduction: Also called the Authorized Version, this edition uses the standardized 1769 text of the King James Bible. Its traditional English vocabulary and phrasing distinguish it from modern-language translations.
KJV.edition_note: This package includes Apocrypha. Public domain outside the UK; UK Crown rights apply.

ASV.title: American Standard Version — 1901
ASV.introduction: An English translation first published in 1901. Its traditional wording includes “Jehovah” in Old Testament passages; it is useful for comparing wording with the World English Bible.
ASV.edition_note: Includes the Old and New Testaments, without Apocrypha.

BSB.title: Berean Standard Bible
BSB.introduction: A modern English Bible produced by the Berean translation project. The text has been dedicated to the public domain and is available for reading, study, and redistribution.
BSB.edition_note: Includes the Old and New Testaments. This package uses the eBible.org BSB export.

DRA.title: Douay–Rheims — American Edition 1899
DRA.introduction: An English Bible translated from the Latin Vulgate. This Catholic edition includes the Deuterocanonical books and uses traditional English.
DRA.edition_note: Psalm numbering and some verse divisions differ from the other editions. Matching reference numbers may not identify equivalent passages.

YLT.title: Young’s Literal Translation — 1898
YLT.introduction: Robert Young’s literal English translation of the Holy Bible. Its distinctive wording includes expressions such as “age-during,” making it useful for close comparison with other translations.
YLT.edition_note: Includes the Old and New Testaments, without Apocrypha.

DBY.title: Darby Bible
DBY.introduction: J. N. Darby’s English translation from the original languages, titled The Holy Scriptures, a New Translation. It uses traditional English and is available in the public domain.
DBY.edition_note: Includes the Old and New Testaments, without Apocrypha.

RV.title: Revised Version — 1895 edition
RV.introduction: A historical English revision of the King James Bible. This downloadable 1895 edition includes the Old Testament, New Testament, and Apocrypha.
RV.edition_note: Original verse ranges and empty source entries are preserved in this package.

ADB1905.title: Ang Dating Biblia / Ang Biblia — 1905
ADB1905.introduction: A complete Tagalog Bible associated with the Philippine Bible Society’s 1905 edition. It retains older Tagalog spelling and wording, including “Dios.”
ADB1905.edition_note: This is the 1905 text, not Ang Biblia 2001. Scripture is Tagalog; the console retains its English book labels.
